name: @lar-factory/desktop
description: The board app: an Electron window that runs the Lar Factory board, copied from T3 Code's desktop app.

scripts.dev: pnpm --dir ../.. run assemble:skills && pnpm --dir ../web run build && vp pack && node scripts/start-electron.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm --dir ../.. run assemble:skills && pnpm --dir ../web run build && vp pack && node scripts/build-desktop-artifact.ts
scripts.test: { test -f ../web/dist/index.html || pnpm --dir ../web run build; } && vp test run
